  • Constructor Details

    • Entry

      public Entry(String equipmentTag, String quantity, double value, String unit, Integer validFromYear, Integer validToYear, String source, EquipmentLimitRegister.Status status, double confidence, String authority, String note)
      Creates an entry.
      Parameters:
      equipmentTag - equipment tag or name (required)
      quantity - limit quantity such as n_max, power_limit or p_out_max (required)
      value - limit value
      unit - unit of the value
      validFromYear - first year the limit applies, or null for open
      validToYear - last year the limit applies, or null for open
      source - document, measurement or rule behind the number
      status - VERIFIED or ASSUMPTION (null is treated as ASSUMPTION)
      confidence - confidence in [0, 1], NaN if not given
      authority - name of a CapacityConstraint.ConstraintSource, null for USER_RULE
      note - free text
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the tag or quantity is empty or the value is not finite
